Container.Name: Hevy Progress
Container.Overview: Colorful, self-hosted analytics dashboard for Hevy workout data. Track consistency, strength progression, training volume, muscle balance, recovery, personal records and your full workout calendar. Sync through the Hevy API or import CSV exports. Unofficial project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Hevy.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: hevy fitness workout gym training analytics progress exercise
Container.Requires: Optional Hevy API key for automatic sync. CSV import can be used without an API key.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Hevy Progress dashboard.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database and application data.

Config.Name: Hevy API Key
Config.Description: Optional Hevy API key for automatic workout synchronization. Leave blank to use CSV import only.

Config.Name: Dashboard Username
Config.Description: Optional dashboard username. Set both username and password to enable HTTP Basic Authentication.

Config.Name: Dashboard Password
Config.Description: Optional dashboard password. Use HTTPS if accessing the dashboard outside your trusted LAN.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for workout dates, calendar days and week boundaries.

Config.Name: Sync Interval
Config.Description: Seconds between automatic Hevy API syncs. Minimum effective value is 300 seconds.
